backend.description: Id of the backend that this Traffic config applies to
backend.rationale: Backend ID is a reference with no direct security implications.

location.description: The location the Backend that this Traffic config applies to
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project specification uses default provider project when not specified.

rollout_policy.description: The policy for how builds and rollouts are triggered and rolled out.

rollout_policy.codebase_branch.description:
Specifies a branch that triggers a new build to be started with this
policy. If not set, no automatic rollouts will happen.
rollout_policy.codebase_branch.rationale: Names the Git branch that triggers automatic rollouts. The branch name is a team workflow choice; a platform policy must not hardcode a specific branch ('main'), and which branch deploys is not a security control.

rollout_policy.disabled.description: A flag that, if true, prevents rollouts from being created via this RolloutPolicy.
rollout_policy.disabled.rationale: Rollout enable/disable flag has no specific security policy.

target.description:
Set to manually control the desired traffic for the backend. This will
cause current to eventually match this value. The percentages must add
up to 100.

target.splits.description: A list of traffic splits that together represent where traffic is being routed.

target.splits.build.description: The build that traffic is being routed to.
target.splits.build.rationale: Build reference has no specific security policy.

target.splits.percent.description: The percentage of traffic to send to the build. Currently must be 100 or 0.
target.splits.percent.rationale: Traffic percentage has no specific security policy.
